Life is full of small surprises. It takes twenty minutes to get to the flower market by bike. Eva wrote about the day in the diary. The eagle circled high above the valley.
Eva is going to travel to Sydney in February. Eva and Owen had great fun there. Eva wants to be a teacher in the future. She expresses her femininity through bold colours and vintage dresses.
Last Monday, Eva and Owen went to the flower market. Both of them like noodles and water. Eva hopes to visit Sydney one day. The noodles come with fresh shrimp.
The flower market is one of the best places in the city. There are always many people at the river bank. Eva bought a T-shirt at the shop yesterday.
